Enter color name; click Add Color

Current UI does not inspect the error field.
The callback ends with an uncaught error.
The page stays open; controls still work.
Chosen action was not Log Out?
Return id and name on match;
Values are bound to a prepared statement.

Models the implemented UI flow, including the no-results behavior.
One request at a time is shown; overlapping asynchronous requests are omitted.
Retrying login and continuing to logout are scenario choices; the user may leave at any time.
Main database actions assume a configured, reachable database and successful SQL.
connectDatabase() exits with JSON on configuration / connection failure.
Network failures and other malformed responses are omitted for readability.
Cookie checking occurs on page load; the API has no server-side session check.
The final node ends this scenario, not the web server or browser.
